python_only_boundaries.arbitrary_gml_labels: Python accepts arbitrary hashable labels; the frozen native loader uses dense label=id.
python_only_boundaries.arbitrary_mapping_truthiness: Dynamic mapping protocols and truthiness remain a cold Python-only boundary.
python_only_boundaries.dictconfig_mutation: Python mutates DictConfig topology.num_nodes; native input documents are immutable.
python_only_boundaries.networkx_private_storage: Python replaces private NetworkX storage with observable partial mutation on failure.
python_only_boundaries.python_dataset_roundtrip_bug: Python cannot round-trip its own empty or non-empty attribute-setting GML spelling; native keeps valid typed GML.
python_only_boundaries.stdout_diagnostics: Python prints load/warning diagnostics; native exposes a typed build report.
python_only_boundaries.torch_seed_side_effects: Torch/CUDA seeding is intentionally deferred with the ML boundary.
